title: Universal .plugin/ Plugin Manifest (observed convention)
description: Manifest at .plugin/plugin.json. There is no cross-vendor specification for this location: it is an observed convention implemented by GitHub Copilot CLI, the OpenHands SDK, vercel/vercel-plugin, and goose. This schema is the union of the field sets those consumers accept. Authored; nothing upstream is vendored.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-plugin-reference (.plugin/plugin.json is first in Copilot's lookup order) ; OpenHands/software-agent-sdk openhands/sdk/plugin/format/claude_code.py and docs.openhands.dev/sdk/guides/plugins ; vercel/vercel-plugin/.plugin/plugin.json ; aaif-goose/goose crates/goose/src/plugins/formats/open_plugins.rs. The originating open-plugin specification is not public (vercel-labs/plugins returns 404), so fields beyond name/version/description are unverified for any single consumer. The agent-plugins.org standard is the real cross-vendor format but mandates a root plugin.json, not .plugin/.

version.description: Required by the vercel-plugin validator; the only real .plugin/plugin.json file declares it.

agents.description: Copilot CLI: path(s) to agent directories containing .agent.md files; default agents/.

skills.description: Path(s) to skill directories containing SKILL.md; default skills/.

hooks.description: Copilot CLI reads hooks.json or hooks/hooks.json; other consumers use hooks/hooks.json.

extensions.description: Copilot CLI extension directories, or { paths: [...], exclusive: true }.

mcpServers.description: Copilot CLI and the other .plugin/ consumers read .mcp.json; the agent-plugins.org standard uses mcp.json instead.

lspServers.description: Copilot CLI: path to an LSP configuration file, or inline server definitions.
